name: whizunik-ai-layer
description: WhizUnik AI layer (Phase 1, advisory / read-only): reference build with a stand-in platform. The production integration lives in the Adventra repository (branch feature/ai-layer).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
